description_en: Initiates an AI agent outbound call from a specific caller number to a called number and returns the call's InstanceId

kebab_example: aliyun ice start-ai-agent-outbound-call --ai-agent-id 00000000000e4f309379701645f40000 --caller-number 18300000333 --called-number 17300000533 --config example-string --user-data city_:_Hangzhou --session-id f213fbc005e4f309379701645f40000 --ims-ai-agent-free-ob-call xx --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartAIAgentOutboundCall
